scaled_synthetic_parallel_lines.description: Scaled synthetic parallel-line factor graph preserving the paper's line reprojection and shared-direction representation claims.
scaled_synthetic_parallel_lines.notes: The paper reports full SLAM benchmark ATE and line angular errors on ICL-NUIM, TartanAir, and Open-Structure. This gym uses a scaled procedural line-only factor graph because the public repository does not ship those full benchmark inputs; paper-derived dimensionality targets are retained and reproduced metrics are computed on the synthetic graph.

median_direction_error_deg.description: Median angular error of recovered 3D line directions on the scored slice.

p90_direction_error_deg.description: Ninetieth-percentile angular direction error, penalizing methods that sacrifice a tail of lines.

median_normal_error_deg.description: Median angular error of recovered Plucker normal vectors on the scored slice.

reprojection_rmse_px.description: Root mean squared image-space endpoint-to-line reprojection error in pixels.

p90_reprojection_error_px.description: Ninetieth-percentile absolute endpoint reprojection error in pixels.

effective_params.description: Machine-independent count of effective line parameters used by the submitted representation.

parallel_spread_deg.description: Average pairwise angular spread among recovered directions in the known parallel group.

scaled_synthetic_parallel_lines_harder.description: Harder scaled synthetic parallel-line factor graph with more lines, more cameras, and larger image noise.
scaled_synthetic_parallel_lines_harder.notes: Additional scaled synthetic setting used to test whether the same compactness and line-geometry behavior persists with more line landmarks and noisier observations; values are not copied from a paper table.
